source_instruction: i am looking for an underwater themed 6 foot by 9 foot light weight vinyl photography backdrop.
query: I just got back from the community garden where I’ve been trying to grow heirloom cherry tomatoes all summer, and the local raccoons keep knocking over my plant stakes to get at the nearly ripe fruit. I spent an hour yesterday rigging up little mesh barriers around each raised bed, and I even stopped by the corner bakery on my walk home to grab a honey oat scone that was still warm from the oven. My neighbor also mentioned that the annual lakeside jazz festival is coming up next month and asked if I wanted to split a picnic blanket to bring, but I told her I’d have to check my schedule first. Anyway, I’m browsing the underwater photography section right now and I need something heavy weight, sized 6x9 ft, and it can’t cost more than $120.
